visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a white chef uniform and a black baseball cap pointing aggressively toward the camera in a modern kitchen setting. In the foreground, a textured grey bowl contains a small portion of reddish food topped with a pale scoop. (2) Rapid sequences show the chef's hands using a red spatula to stir a white milky liquid in a silver pot over a blue gas flame. He then pours the heated cream into a metal bowl containing green chopped herbs and later into a plastic cylinder. (3) The chef stands next to a black and silver Ninja Creami appliance. Detailed shots focus on the control panel where he presses buttons for 'ICE CREAM'. The machine whirs as it processes the contents inside a clear outer bowl. (4) A wooden platter is shown holding segments of raw ground beef, chopped onions, capers, and a single raw egg yolk. The chef's gloved hands sprinkle black pepper and pour oil over the ingredients before mixing them together. (5) The chef uses a black spoon to take a bite of the finished beef tartare topped with truffle ice cream. His facial expression is one of surprise and deep satisfaction as he chews and looks directly at the lens. (6) A new cooking phase begins with the chef frying chopped bacon in a small pan. He adds white sugar and then a handful of whole red cherry tomatoes, tossing them until they are coated in a glossy syrup. (7) He pours the tomato mixture into a pot, adds cream, and zests a lime over it. The mixture is blended and poured into a container for freezing. The Ninja Creami is used again, this time selecting the 'GELATO' function. (8) The chef spreads a vibrant orange tomato-basil sorbet onto a piece of toasted garlic bread. He takes a large bite, exhibiting a joyful and refreshed expression while nodding his head in approval.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and a challenging tone. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic background track with a driving percussion beat and bright synthesizer pads begins. The vocal pitch is moderate with high variability, indicating excitement. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The speaker's tone becomes instructional and calm. Incidental sounds of a metal pot clinking and a spatula stirring liquid are audible over the continuous, steady tempo of the electronic music. (3) The acoustic environment is dominated by the mechanical whirring of an ice cream machine, which has a consistent mid-frequency drone. The speaker pauses briefly, then returns with a confident, authoritative delivery, emphasizing the machine's capabilities. (4) High-frequency sizzling sounds of frying bacon and the percussive clinking of kitchen utensils are prominent. The BGM maintains its energy, while the narrator's voice exhibits clear articulation and a friendly, persuasive prosody as he explains the second recipe. (5) A distinct crunching sound occurs as the chef bites into toasted bread. The music reaches a peak in volume before fading slightly. The speaker's voice concludes with a satisfied, high-arousal tone, praising the product with strong vocal dominance.
